shortDescription: Controller & joystick test: stick drift, buttons, input lag, vibration, deadzone
tagline: Controller, Joystick & Stick Drift Tester for Android

sections.title: Controller, Joystick & Stick Drift Tester for Android
paragraphs: Test any Bluetooth, USB or OTG gamepad on your Android phone or tablet in seconds. Gamepad Tester Pro is a complete controller tester and joystick checker: check buttons, analog sticks, stick drift, dead zone, triggers, vibration, input lag and polling rate, then get a health score and a shareable report. Works with Xbox, PlayStation (DualShock 4, DualSense), Switch Pro and generic controllers.

sections.title: Popular ways people use this app
bullets: Check stick drift and dead zone before buying or selling a used controller
Confirm a new gamepad works before the return or warranty window closes
Diagnose missed inputs, double presses, sticky buttons or a dead trigger
Compare Bluetooth vs USB polling rate and input lag before a ranked match

sections.title: Full Controller Test & Health Score
bullets: One guided test for buttons, D-pad, analog sticks, L2/R2 triggers, stick drift and vibration
Overall health score with per-item results, saved to Test History automatically
Export and share a visual test report for support, repairs or resale listings

sections.title: Button Test & Joystick Test in Real Time
bullets: See every press, release and Android key code instantly
Visualize both analog sticks, axes, D-pad and analog trigger pressure
Layouts for Xbox, PlayStation, generic gamepads and TV remotes

sections.title: Stick Drift Test, Dead Zone & Circularity
bullets: Live stick position, resting offset and a dead-zone guide
Advanced stick analysis: coverage, circularity error, radius range and dead-zone estimation

sections.title: Input Lag, Latency & Polling Rate Test
bullets: Estimated polling rate in Hz, average, minimum and maximum input interval
Advanced sampling: jitter, interval histogram, Bluetooth vs USB session comparison, CSV export

sections.title: Vibration Test & Rumble Studio
bullets: Test left and right rumble motor strength independently
Vibration Studio: build multi-segment dual-motor patterns, loop and save them

sections.title: LED Light Test (PlayStation over Bluetooth)
bullets: Set the light bar color, then run solid-color, hue sweep and breathing checks
Spot dead spots, color tint, jumps or flicker
Needs DualShock 4 or DualSense over Bluetooth, Android 12+. Wired PS, Xbox and other pads keep their light closed to Android, so the app says why instead of showing a dead color picker.

sections.title: Gyroscope, Touchpad & Dual Controller Compare
bullets: Gyroscope, accelerometer and tilt level for DualShock 4, DualSense and Switch Pro (Android 12+)
Touchpad test with multi-touch trails and press counter

sections.title: Controller Info & Health Trends
paragraphs: View brand, device name, Vendor ID, Product ID, connection type, axes, button count, vibration support and battery level when exposed. Test History tracks health score and drift trends per controller, so you catch a failing stick early.

sections.title: Please note
bullets: Features depend on the controller model, connection type, Android version and phone maker. Some controllers do not report battery, vibration, motion sensors or a touchpad to Android.
The app reads input only. It cannot remap buttons, update firmware or repair hardware.
Core tests are free with ads. Pro is a one-time purchase that removes ads and unlocks advanced diagnostics, health trends, CSV export and saved vibration patterns.

sections.title: Something not working?
paragraphs: If your controller is not detected or a result looks wrong, please email feedback@dapplebyte.com before leaving a review. Tell us your controller and phone model and we will help. Most issues can be fixed in the next update.
